title: Edge KKL lower bound
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with positive variance. If $I(f)$ is the sum of its coordinate influences, $V(f)$ its variance, and $I_{\max}(f)$ its largest coordinate influence, then $9\cdot 9^{-I(f)/V(f)}/(I(f)/V(f))^2\leq I_{\max}(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
The variance of f is positive
